scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @clinic/server" "npm run dev -w @clinic/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clinic/shared && npm run typecheck -w @clinic/server && npm run typecheck -w @clinic/web && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w @clinic/server && npm run test -w @clinic/web && npm run test -w @clinic/desktop
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
